additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Shahin,
Thank you for raising the issue. There was a communication error in your charger. We have done soft reset remotely and the charger is working fine.
The remaining part is the issue with converter remain off. Its because of, you have choose power save mode. When the charger will go operational. The converter will open automatically.
I hope the problem solved. I am going to close the ticket.
If you have further issue please raise a new ticket. We are always here to support as soon as possible.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
